property_summary: After any admissible call to fallback with exactly 10 ether, the contract's balance becomes 0 if and only if block.number % 15 == 0; the buggy version instead sets balance to 0 when block.number % 15 != 0, violating the rule.
change_summary: Replace block.number % 15 == 0 with block.number % 15 != 0 in the if condition
